reading_material.overview: Percentages is a high-frequency aptitude area because it tests both conceptual clarity and execution speed. Candidates should study it in layers: definitions, core rules, standard patterns, edge cases, timed practice, and post-test error analysis.
core_ideas_to_master: A percentage is a ratio with denominator 100, so every percentage must have a base.
Successive changes are multiplicative, not additive.
A percent decrease from a larger base is not symmetrical with the same percent increase from a smaller base.
Percentage point difference compares two percentage values directly.
